name: Activated abilities of the top card of your library — Conspicuous Snoop, Skill Borrower
notes: Found by tests/sweep.py. The card comes from the controller's 'Top of library' slot (Battlefield.setLibraryTop, player.libraryTop). The opponent's top card is Prodigal Sorcerer, an artifact-or-creature card, so the opponent's Skill Borrower has its ability.
